blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Raindrops adhered to camera lens or windshield are inevitable in rainy scenes and can become an issue for many computer vision systems such as autonomous driving. Because raindrop appearance is affected by too many parameters, it is unlikely to find an effective model based solution. Learning based methods are also problematic, because traditional learning method cannot properly model the complex appearance. Whereas deep learning method lacks sufficiently large and realistic training data. To solve it, in our work, we propose the first photo-realistic dataset of synthetic adherent raindrops with pixel-level mask for training. The rendering is physics based with consideration of the water dynamic, geometric and photometry. The dataset contains various types of rainy scenes and particularly the rainy driving scenes. Based on the modeling of raindrop imagery, we introduce a detection network which has the awareness of the raindrop refraction as well as its blurring. Based on that, we propose the removal network that can well recover the image structure. Rigorous experiments demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of our proposed framework.
blocks.zh: 雨滴坚持摄像头镜头或挡风玻璃在雨景中是不可避免的,可以成为许多计算机视觉系统如自主驾驶的问题. 由于雨滴外观受到太多参数的影响,因此不太可能找到有效的基于模型的解决方案. 基于学习的方法也有问题,因为传统的学习方法无法适当地模拟复杂的外观. 深层学习方法缺乏足够大和现实的培训数据。 为了解决这个问题,我们在工作中提出了第一个带有像素级口罩的合成附着雨滴的光现实化数据集,用于训练. 渲染是物理上的,考虑到水的动态,几何和光度. 数据集包含各种类型的降雨场景,特别是降雨驾驶场景. 基于雨滴图像的模型制作,我们引入了一个探测网络,对雨滴折射及其模糊性有了认识。 在此基础上,我们提出可以完全恢复图像结构的移除网络. 严格的实验展示了我们拟议框架的最新业绩。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Visual comparison of raindrop removal in real rainy scenes. Our method removes most of raindrops although the raindrops have large variety.
blocks.zh: 图 1:真实雨景中雨滴清除的视觉对比. 我们的方法清除了大部分的雨滴,尽管雨滴有很多种类.

blocks.en: Most computer vision studies assume that the input image is of good visibility and clean content. However, rainy weather causes several different types of degradation to the image captured. It is common that the raindrops hit and flow on a camera lens or a windscreen of the vehicle. These adherent raindrops can obstruct, deform, and/or blur part of the area in the imagery of the background scenes, and then significantly degrade the performances of many vision algorithms e.g . feature detection [ 26 , 12 , 25 ] , tracking [ 34 , 5 , 31 ] , stereo correspondence [ 29 , 30 , 9 ] , etc . A method to automatically remove the raindrop and recover the clear scene is, therefore, desired.
blocks.zh: 大多数计算机视觉研究假设输入图像具有良好的能见度和干净的内容. 然而,雨性天气导致捕获的图像有几种不同类型的退化. 通常,雨滴击中并流淌在摄像头或车辆的挡风玻璃上。 这些粘着的雨滴可以在背景场景的图像中阻碍,变形和/或模糊部分区域,然后显著降低许多视觉算法的性能,如特征检测[26,12,25],跟踪[34,5,31],立体通信[29,30,9]等. 因此,需要一种方法来自动移除降雨并恢复清晰的场景。

blocks.en:
Unlike the rain streaks [ 36 , 21 ] , that mostly are thin and vertical stripes, adherent raindrops have more varieties in shape, position, and size, as can be seem in Fig. 1 a.
You et al . [ 39 , 38 , 37 ] , Roser et al . [ 27 ] , Eigen et al . [ 6 ] and Qian et al . [ 24 ] are a few example approaches focusing on detecting or removing the adherent raindrops. However, the method in [ 39 ] requires the rich temporal information, whereas the required video sequence cannot be applied to single image. Roser et al . ’s method [ 27 ] can detect raindrop from a single image, but the model is over simplified and far from the real cases. Rather than model based methods, Eigen et al . [ 6 ] first adopt deep neural network, but the network only contains three layers and cannot properly learn the appearance of real raindrops. Qian et al . [ 24 ] integrate attention mechanism into GAN based CNNs, but their method is only tested on a small dataset. Although their dataset uses real raindrop, but the scene is in sunny day, which is not realistic. And therefore their method cannot fully handle real rainy scenes (Fig. 1 c).
blocks.zh:
与雨花[36,21]不同的是,雨花多为细条纹和垂直条纹,附着的雨滴在形状,位置,大小上都有较多的品种,如图1a所示.
你和他人[39、38、37]、Roser等人[27]、Eigen等人[6]和Qian等人[24],是侧重于探测或消除固态雨滴的几个例子。 然而,[39]中的方法需要丰富的时间信息,而所需要的视频序列则不能适用于单个图像. Roser et al. 的方法[27]可以从单一的图像中检测雨滴,但模型过于简化,与真实案例相去甚远. Eigen et al. [6] 与其基于模型的方法,不如首先采用深层神经网络,但网络只包含三层,无法正确了解真实雨滴的外观. Qian et al. [24] 将关注机制整合到基于GAN的CNN中,但其方法只在一个小数据集上测试. 虽然他们的数据集使用了真正的降雨,但场景是在阳光灿烂的一天,这不现实. 因此,他们的方法不能完全处理真正的雨景(图1c)。

blocks.en:
In this paper, we propose a physics driven as well as data driven method to detect and remove the adherent raindrops jointly.
We utilize the realistic adherent raindrops imagery model proposed by Roser et al . [ 28 ] and You et al . [ 39 ] .
Based on understanding the physics, we design a novel deep learning multi-tasks network which does both end to end detection and removal adherent raindrops from a single image. Unlike existing networks, the proposed network directly reflects the appearance of raindrop such that it is partially blended into the image and is a reflection of the background image.
In brief, we separate the difficult task of restoring image into three sub-problems: ( i ) detect raindrop locations and shapes via a deeply supervised sub-network, and then ( ii ) restore adherent raindrop regions through deep learning network, subsequently ( iii ) a small CNN network is employed to smooth the blended image.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们提出一种物理驱动和数据驱动的方法,以便共同探测和清除粘着的雨滴。
我们利用Roser等人[28]和You等[39]提出的现实雨滴图像模型。
基于对物理学的理解,我们设计了一个新的深层学习多任务网络,它既能结束探测,又能从单一的图像中去除固态的雨滴. 与现有网络不同的是,拟议网络直接反映雨滴的外观,使其部分混入图像,是背景图像的反映.
简而言之,我们把恢复图像的艰巨任务分为三个子问题:(一)通过一个深层监管的子网络检测降雨位置和形状,然后(二)通过深层学习网络恢复粘着的降雨区域,随后(三)利用一个小型CNN网络来平滑混合图像.

blocks.en:
To enable proper training of the network, a new dataset is introduced which consisting photo-realistic rendering of the rainy scenes and clear scenes.
The dataset uses Cityscapes dataset [ 4 ] as background image, which contains representative outdoor scenes. The dataset contains about 30 ​ K 30K images. Each image has 50 to 70 raindrops with size varying from 0.8 to 1.5 centimeters, and the blurring level varying from 7 to 20 pixel.
blocks.zh:
为了能够对网络进行适当培训,引入了一个新的数据集,其中包括对雨场景和清晰场景的摄影真实化渲染。
该数据集使用Cityscapes数据集[4]作为背景图像,其中包含了具有代表性的户外场景. 该数据集包含约30K 30K图像. 每个图像有50到70个雨滴,大小从0.8厘米到1.5厘米不等,模糊度从7到20像素不等.

blocks.en: This paper makes the following contributions: • We propose a physics aware end-to-end neural network for joint raindrop detection and removal. The architecture is designed in cope with the physics of raindrop imagery. • We develop a practical dataset of realistically rendered adherent raindrop images, which contains the pixel-level raindrop binary masks. • The proposed method significantly out performances existing methods on all existing dataset and real-world rainy images.
blocks.zh: • 本文件作出以下贡献: 我们建议建立一个物理意识的端到端神经网络,用于联合探测和清除降雨。 该建筑的设计与雨滴图像的物理学相适应。 我们开发了一个实用的数据集,其中包含像素级的雨滴二进制口罩。 拟议的方法大大取消了所有现有数据集和现实世界雨量图像的现有方法。

blocks.en: We propose a physics aware end-to-end neural network for joint raindrop detection and removal. The architecture is designed in cope with the physics of raindrop imagery.
blocks.zh: 我们建议建立一个物理意识的端到端神经网络,用于联合探测和清除降雨。 该建筑的设计是针对雨滴影像的物理学.

blocks.en: We develop a practical dataset of realistically rendered adherent raindrop images, which contains the pixel-level raindrop binary masks.
blocks.zh: 我们开发了一个实用的数据集, 包含像素级的雨滴二进制口罩。

blocks.en: The proposed method significantly out performances existing methods on all existing dataset and real-world rainy images.
blocks.zh: 拟议的方法大大取消了所有现有数据集和现实世界雨量图像的现有方法。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Removing raindrops from a single image is an ill-posed problem and would be beneficial to outdoor computer vision systems which work in bad weather, particularly surveillance systems and intelligent vehicle systems. Although there are many papers focus on removing haze [ 13 , 2 ] or rain streaks [ 22 , 21 , 42 ] , the researches on raindrop removal from a single image are relatively insufficient.
blocks.zh: 从单一图像中去除降雨量是一个不易处理的问题,对在恶劣天气中起作用的室外计算机视觉系统,特别是监测系统和智能车辆系统,将是有益的。 虽然有许多论文强调清除雾霾[13,2]或雨痕[22,21,42],但从单一图像中清除雨滴的研究相对不足.

blocks.en: 2.1 Adherent Raindrop Modeling
blocks.zh: 2.1 连续雨滴模型

blocks.en: Halimeh et al . [ 11 ] introduce a raindrop modeling method based on ray-tracking. They propose an algorithm which models the geometric shape of a raindrop by utilizing its photometric properties. Roser et al . [ 28 ] mainly focus on modeling the raindrop geometric shape. They leverage the Bézier curves to represent a raindrop surface in low dimensions which is physically interpretable. Von Bernuth et al . [ 32 ] propose a novel method to render these raindrops using Continuous Nearest Neighbor search leveraging the benefits of R-trees. They use the synthetic raindrops for robustness verification of camera-based object recognition.
blocks.zh: Halimeh et al. [11] 引入基于射线跟踪的降雨模型方法. 他们提出了一个算法,通过利用雨滴的光度特性来模拟雨滴的几何形状。 Roser et al. [28] 主要关注雨滴几何形状的建模. 它们利用贝塞尔曲线来代表低维的雨滴表面,这在物理上是可以解释的. 冯 Bernuth et al. [32] 提出一种新颖的方法,利用近邻连续搜索利用R树的好处来制作这些雨滴. 他们使用合成雨滴来进行强力验证,以照相机为基础的物体识别.

blocks.en: Recently, You et al . [ 40 ] model raindrops by considering both liquid dynamics and optics. They reconstruct the 3D geometry of a raindrop by minimizing surface energy constraints and total reflection constraint. The accurate raindrop model proposed by You et al . can be used in applications such as depth estimation and image refocusing. Later, You et al . [ 39 ] model adherent raindrops by taking consideration of physical properties such as gravity, water-water surface tensor and water-adhering-surface tensor.
blocks.zh: 近来, 通过考虑液态动力学和光学 模拟降雨 它们通过尽量减少表面能量限制和总反射限制来重建雨滴的3D几何. You et al.提出的准确的降雨模型可用于深度估计和图像重定向等应用. 后来 通过考虑重力、水-水表面抗热器和水-水-水表面抗热器等物理特性,你和他人[39]模型固态降雨。

blocks.en: 2.2 Raindrop Removal
blocks.zh: 2.2 雨滴清除

blocks.en: Most existing methods for detecting or removing raindrops are stereo or video based and therefore not applicable to a single image. Roser and Geiger [ 27 ] propose a method which detects raindrop in a single image based on a photometric raindrop model. The raindrop detection can improve image registration accuracy, then removing raindrops by fusing multiple views into one frame. You et al . [ 39 ] combine video completion technique with temporal intensity derivative to remove raindrops in video after detecting the locations of raindrops.
blocks.zh: 大多数现有的探测或清除雨滴的方法都是基于立体声或视频的,因此不适用于单个图像. Roser and Geiger [27] 提出一种方法,在光度测雨滴模型的基础上,在单一图像中探测雨滴. 雨滴检测可以提高图像注册的准确性,然后通过将多个视图放入一个框架来消除雨滴. You et al. [39] 结合视频完成技术与时间强度衍生技术,在探测到雨滴的位置后,去除视频中的降雨.

blocks.en: Due to the lack of temporal information, raindrop removal from a single image is more challenging. Eigen et al . ’s work [ 6 ] is the first one to remove raindrops from a single image. They propose a 3-layer CNN network trained on rainy/clear pairs, the network can remove relatively sparse and small raindrops as well as dirt. However, the method suffers from blurred outputs and cannot remove dense raindrops. Recently, Qian et al . [ 24 ] propose a method based on GAN [ 10 ] . They create an aligned dataset by using a piece of glass sprayed with water to get images containing raindrops. With this dataset, they propose a GAN based network which integrates attention mechanism both in generator and discriminator. The method can produce sharp and clear image on their test set.
blocks.zh: 由于缺乏时间信息,从单一图像中除去降雨更具挑战性. Eigen et al.的作品[6]是第一个从单一图像中删除雨滴的作品. 他们提议建立一个3层的CNN网络,培训内容为雨/晴的对子,该网络可以清除相对稀少的小雨滴和泥土。 然而,这种方法的输出模糊不清,无法清除密集的雨滴. 近来, Q等人. [24] 提出基于GAN的方法[10]. 它们通过使用用水喷出的玻璃片来获得包含雨滴的图像来创建一个对齐的数据集. 通过这一数据集,他们提议建立一个基于GAN的网络,将生成者和歧视者的注意力机制结合起来。 该方法可以在他们的测试集中产生尖锐清晰的图像.

blocks.en: There are also some general Image-to-Image translation methods such as Pix2Pix [ 17 ] can tackle this problem, but they are not specifically designed for raindrop removal from a single image.
blocks.zh: 还有一些一般的图像到图像翻译方法,如Pix2Pix[17]可以解决这个问题,但它们并不是专门为从单一图像中除去雨滴而设计的.

blocks.en: 3 Raindrop Imagery Model and Photorealistic Dataset
blocks.zh: 3 雨滴图像模型和照片现实化数据集

blocks.en: As preliminary, we briefly introduce the raindrop imagery model developed by Roser et al . [ 28 ] and extended by You et al . [ 39 ] and the implementation detail on our photorealistic dataset generated from such model. It will later drive us to design the network structure in Sec. 4 . Also, we introduce the detail of the new photo realistic dataset.
blocks.zh: 作为初步,我们简要介绍由Roser等人[28]开发、由You等人[39]扩展的雨滴图像模型,以及我们从这种模型中生成的光现实化数据集的实施细节。 它会推动我们设计网络结构 在Sec.4。 此外,我们介绍新的照片现实数据集的细节。

blocks.en:
Data driven methods, particularly deep neural networks, need a large training data with ground truth.
In particular, we need images with raindrops and the corresponding clear images to perform supervised learning in the context of raindrop removal from a single image.
However, it is difficult and expensive to get strictly aligned rainy/clear image pairs of the exact same scene. Qian et al . [ 24 ] create a dataset contains 1119 1119 pairs in total. The dataset is the only one for adherent raindrops, but it is relatively small and lacks the pixel-level masks of raindrops. In order to train our network, we create the first photo-realistic adherent raindrop dataset with pixel-level mask in autonomous driving settings based on Cityscapes dataset [ 4 ] . Inspired by [ 11 ] and [ 28 ] , we synthesize adherent raindrop appearance on a clear background image by tracking the ray from camera to environment through the raindrops.
blocks.zh:
数据驱动方法,特别是深层神经网络,需要大量具有地面真实性的训练数据.
特别是,我们需要带有雨滴的图像和相应的清晰图像,以便在从单一图像中清除雨滴的情况下进行有监督的学习。
然而,很难和昂贵地获得完全相同场景的绝对对齐的雨/清晰图像对。 Qian et al. [24] 创建一个数据集,共包含1119个1119对. 该数据集是唯一一个用于固态雨滴的,但相对较小,缺乏雨滴的像素级口罩. 为了训练我们的网络,我们根据Cityscapes数据集[4],在自主驱动设置中创建了第一个带有像素级遮罩的摄影现实式粘着雨滴数据集. 在[11]和[28]的启发下,我们通过雨滴跟踪从相机到环境的射线,在清晰的背景图像上合成了粘着的雨滴外观.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Refraction model. The light ray colored in green does not go through any raindrops. The light ray colored in yellow goes through a raindrop and is refracted twice.
blocks.zh: 图2:折射模型。 绿色的光线不会穿过任何雨滴。 黄色的光线穿过雨滴,被反射两次.

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 2 , in order to get the synthetic adherent raindrop images, we set a scene with a camera at the origin, a glass plane at N N centimeters ahead the camera, and a background plane at T T centimeters ahead the camera. The angle between the glass plane and the ground is ψ \psi . On the glass plane, we randomly sprinkle raindrops and ignore the refraction introduced by glass. A raindrop is modeled by spherical cap where the radius of the sphere is r r and the angle between tangent and glass plane is τ \tau . These two parameters determine the volume of the raindrop in glass. If a light ray determined by origin and the location of a pixel in image plane does not go through any raindrops, we set the pixel value unchanged as the background pixel. On the contrary, if a light ray goes through a raindrop in glass plane, we track the light ray by considering the refraction introduced by the raindrop, and set the pixel to the crossover point of light ray and the background plane. In Fig. 2 , the light ray represented by the green line does not go through any raindrop, so we keep the corresponding pixel in image plane unchanged. The light ray represented by yellow line is refracted twice and reaches the same point in the background plane as the green line, so we set the corresponding pixel in image plane same as the green line. If total reflection happened when the light ray propagates from the inside of a raindrop to the air, we set the corresponding pixel in image plane to black. This phenomenon is quite common at real world raindrop’s boundary which called dark bands [ 40 ] .
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,为了获得合成附着的雨滴影像,我们设定了一个场景,镜头的源头是照相机,镜头前方是N厘米的玻璃平面,镜头前方是T厘米的背景平面. 玻璃平面和地面之间的角度是\psi。 在玻璃平面上,我们随机喷洒雨滴,忽略玻璃带来的折射. 雨滴由球盖建模,球体半径为rr,正切和玻璃平面之间的角度为\tau。 这两个参数决定了玻璃中的降雨量. 如果由来源和图像平面中一个像素的位置所决定的光线没有经过任何雨滴,我们就将像素值设定为背景像素不变. 相反,如果一个光线在玻璃平面上穿过雨滴,我们通过考虑雨滴引入的折射来跟踪光线,并将像素设定到光线和背景平面的交叉点. 在图2中,以绿线为代表的光线不会穿过任何雨滴,所以图像平面中相应的像素保持不变. 以黄线为代表的光线两次折射,在背景平面上达到与绿线相同的点,因此我们在图像平面上设定了与绿线相同的相应像素. 如果光线从雨滴的内侧传播到空气中时发生总反射,那么我们将图像平面中相应的像素设定为黑色. 这种现象在真实世界的雨滴边界上相当普遍,

blocks.en: Figure 3: Samples of our synthetic raindrop images. Top: The ground truth clear image in Cityscapes dataset [ 4 ] . Middle: The synthetic raindrop image produced by our refraction model. Bottom: The ground truth binary mask of the raindrops.
blocks.zh: 图3:我们合成雨滴图像样本。 顶部 : Cityscapes数据集中的地面真相清晰图像 [4]. 中间 : 我们的折射模型产生的合成雨滴图像。 底部 : 雨滴的地面真相二进制面具.

blocks.en: In the real world, raindrops will be blurred when a camera focuses on the environment scene. We use a disk blur kernel to blur the areas occupied by raindrops in synthetic image. As we observed, it is more realistic for the scene in our dataset to set the diameter of the disk blur kernel to be 7 ∼ 20 7\sim 20 pixels. Since we already know the locations of raindrops on glass, it is also very convenient to get the ground truth pixel-level binary mask of raindrop image.
blocks.zh: 在现实世界,当一个镜头聚焦于环境场景时,雨滴会变得模糊. 我们用磁盘模糊的内核来模糊合成图像中被雨滴占据的区域. 正如我们所观察到的,我们数据集中的场景将磁盘模糊内核的直径设定为7 ∼ 20 7\sim 20像素,更为现实. 既然我们已经知道玻璃上的雨滴位置,那么也非常方便地获得地面真实像素级的雨滴图像二进制面具.

blocks.en: We use images in Cityscapes [ 4 ] as the background images. Unlike the dataset created by Qian et al . [ 24 ] which is based on campus scenes, the scenes in Cityscapes are mainly focus on urban street where most outdoor vision systems work. And there are many data recorded in cloudy weather in Cityscapes, while the data in Qian’s dataset is recorded in fine weather. So our dataset is more suitable for raindrop removal in outdoor vision systems especially autonomous driving.
blocks.zh: 我们在Cityscapes[4]中的图像作为背景图像. 与Qian et al.[24]基于校园场景创建的数据集不同,Cityscapes中的场景主要集中于大多数户外视觉系统运作的城市街道. 而Cityscapes的云层天气中记录了许多数据,而Qian数据集中的数据则记录在细微的天气中. 所以我们的数据集更适合在户外视觉系统中 清除雨滴,特别是自主驾驶。

blocks.en: In order to make the raindrop appearance close to real ones, we set N ∈ [ 20 , 40 ] N\in[20,40] , T ∈ [ 800 , 1500 ] T\in[800,1500] , r ∈ [ 0.8 , 1.5 ] r\in[0.8,1.5] , ψ ∈ [ 30 ​ ° , 45 ​ ° ] \psi\in[$$,$$] and τ ∈ [ 30 ​ ° , 45 ​ ° ] \tau\in[$$,$$] . For each background image, we generate 50 50 to 70 70 raindrops. Finally, we make a dataset containing about 30000 30000 images based on the training set of Cityscapes for training and 1525 1525 images based on the test set of Cityscapes for testing.
blocks.zh: 为了让降雨的外观接近真实的,我们设定了[20,40] N\[20,40],T\[800,1500] T\in[800,1500],r\[0.8,1.5] r\[0.8,1.5] r\ r\ [30°,45°] \ psi\ in [$,$,$] 和\\\ 30°,45°] tau\ n[$,$,$]. 每个背景图像,我们生成50到70个雨滴。 最后,我们制作一个数据集,其中包含基于Cityscapes培训集的大约300003,000张图像,以及基于Cityscapes测试集的1525张1525张图像.

blocks.en: 4 End-to-End Raindrop Detection and Removal Network
blocks.zh: 4 尾到尾降雨探测和清除网络

blocks.en: Figure 4: Network architecture of our proposed method. The whole architecture consists of three sub-networks for raindrop detection, raindrop region reconstruction and refining respectively.
blocks.zh: 图4:我们拟议方法的网络结构。 整个建筑由三个子网络组成,分别用于雨滴探测,雨滴地区重建和精炼.

blocks.en: We devise an end-to-end multi-task network which explicitly incorporate the raindrop imagery model. The observed raindrop degraded image 𝐎 \mathbf{O} can be modeled as 𝐎 = ( 1 − 𝐌 ) ​ 𝐁 + 𝐑 \mathbf{O}=(1-\mathbf{M})\mathbf{B}+\mathbf{R} . Where 𝐌 \mathbf{M} is raindrop binary mask, 𝐁 \mathbf{B} is the clear background image and 𝐑 \mathbf{R} is the raindrop layer. Based on this model, it is intuitive to separate the difficult task into three sub-problems: the first sub-network of our proposed method is designed to detect the raindrop binary mask 𝐌 \mathbf{M} , the second is designed to restore the regions occupied by raindrops, the third is designed to smooth and refine the blended image. As shown in Fig. 4 , our proposed raindrop removal network consists of three sub-networks to address the three sub-problems respectively. In this section, we first introduce these sub-networks in detail. Then, by combining all sub-networks, we describe the whole architecture of our proposed network and some implementation details.
blocks.zh: 我们设计了一个端到端的多任务网络,明确纳入雨滴图像模型。 观测到的降雨退化图像 O\ mathbf{O} 可以建模为 O = (1 - M) B + R\ mathbf{O} (1-\ mathbf{M})\ mathbf{B}+\mathbf{R}. M\ mathbf{M} 是雨滴二进制掩码的地方, B\ mathbf{B} 是清晰的背景图像, R\ mathbf{R} 是雨滴层 。 基于这个模型,将困难的任务分为三个子问题是直观的:我们拟议方法的第一个子网络是用来检测降雨二进制面具M\mathbf{M},第二个是用来恢复降雨占用的区域,第三个是用来平滑和完善混合图像的. 如图4所示,我们拟议的雨滴清除网络由三个子网络组成,分别解决三个子问题。 在本节中,我们首先详细介绍这些子网络. 然后,通过合并所有子网络,我们描述我们拟议网络的整个结构以及一些执行细节。

blocks.en: 4.1 Raindrop Detection Network
blocks.zh: 4.1 雨滴探测网络

blocks.en: The purpose of our raindrop detection network is to detect the areas of raindrops from input image. The network outputs a pixel-level binary mask in which the pixels of raindrops are marked as ones and the pixels of raindrop-free background are marked as zeros. We can separate the raindrops layer from the background layer by leveraging this binary mask.
blocks.zh: 我们的雨滴探测网络的目的是从输入图像中检测雨滴的区域. 网络输出一个像素级的二进制掩码,其中雨滴的像素标记为一,无雨滴背景的像素标记为零. 我们可以利用这个二进制面具,把雨滴层与背景层分开.

blocks.en: Our raindrop detection network is inspired by I-CNN [ 7 ] and contains stacked residual blocks [ 14 , 15 ] . Different from the general semantic segmentation or detection networks [ 41 , 12 , 3 ] , the binary mask of raindrops has little semantic information. Hence, we just downsample the internal feature maps to half size in order to enlarge the receptive field. It makes the feature maps denser and keeps more accurate location information.
blocks.zh: 我们的雨滴探测网络受到I-CNN[7]的启发,包含堆叠的残块[14,15]. 与一般语义分区或检测网络[41,12,3]不同,雨滴的二进制面具几乎没有语义信息. 因此,我们只是将内部的地物图样本缩小到一半,以扩大可接受域。 它使地物图更密集,并保存更准确的位置信息.

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 4 , the proposed raindrop detection network has 5 5 convolution layers and 6 6 residual blocks. In the second convolution layer which with stride 2, the resolution of feature maps is reduced to the half of input image. There is a 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolution layer in which the channels of feature maps increase from 64 64 to 256 256 . In order to reduce the training time and memory usage, we use residual block in bottleneck fashion. The residual block consists of two 1 × 1 1\times 1 and one 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolution layers, where the 1 × 1 1\times 1 layers will reduce/increase the channels of internal feature maps to 64 64 / 256 256 respectively, and the middle 3 × 3 3\times 3 layer has 64-dimensional feature maps in both input and output. All convolution layers in our proposed network are followed by batch normalization (BN) [ 16 ] and ReLU [ 23 ] . We use the binary cross-entropy as loss function of the raindrop detection network, and the loss defined as: ℒ d ​ e ​ t ( M , M ^ ) = − 1 n ∑ i n [ M i log ( M ^ i ) + ( 1 − M i ) log ( 1 − M ^ i ) ] , \small\mathcal{L}_{det}(M,\hat{M})=-\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i}^{n}\left[M_{i}\log(\hat{M}_{i})+(1-M_{i})\log(1-\hat{M}_{i})\right], (1) where M M is the ground truth binary mask, M ^ \hat{M} is probability mask predicted by our network, n n is the number of pixels in mask, and i i is pixel index.

blocks.en: 4.2 Raindrop Region Reconstruction Network
blocks.zh: 4.2 降雨区重建网络

blocks.en: The raindrop region reconstruction network is designed to recover the areas occupied by blurred raindrops according to the contextual information, and it shares the similar CNN architecture with the proposed raindrop detection network. Different from the raindrop detection network, we increase the number of residual blocks from 6 6 to 8 8 . We combine the input image and the edge of input image to a 4 4 -channel tensor as the input. The edge cues can help tasks like reflection removal and image smoothing according to [ 19 , 20 , 35 ] . By introducing λ \lambda , our network will pay more attention to reconstruct the raindrop region.

blocks.en: 4.3 Refine network
blocks.zh: 4.3 完善网络

blocks.en: Combing the two sub-networks described above, we propose the refine network. The blended input image B B of refine network is defined as: B = M ^ ​ I ^ + ( 𝟏 − M ^ ) ​ R , B=\hat{M}\hat{I}+(\mathbf{1}-\hat{M})R, (4) where R R is raindrop image, M ^ \hat{M} is binary mask produced by raindrop detection sub-network, and I ^ \hat{I} is the output of raindrop region reconstruction sub-network. B B consists of background pixels in R R and reconstructed pixels in I ^ \hat{I} . The architecture of refine network is relatively simple, it contains two convolution layers and two residual blocks. To train the refine network by considering both image structure similarity and color similarity [ 43 ] , we use loss function mixed with SSIM [ 33 ] loss and ℓ 1 \ell_{1} loss. ℒ r ​ e ​ f ​ ( I , I ~ ) = α ⁡ ( 1 − ℒ s ​ s ​ i ​ m ​ ( I , I ~ ) ) + ( 1 − α ) ​ ℒ ℓ 1 ​ ( I , I ~ ) , \mathcal{L}_{ref}(I,\tilde{I})=\alpha(1-\mathcal{L}_{ssim}(I,\tilde{I}))+(1-\alpha)\mathcal{L}_{\ell_{1}}(I,\tilde{I}), (5) where I ~ \tilde{I} is output of our refine network ( i.e . final output of our proposed method). We set the α = 0.3 \alpha=0.3 .

B 由 R R 中的背景像素和 I ^\ hat{I}中重建的像素组成. 精炼网络的架构相对简单,包含两个演化层和两个残块. 为了训练精制网络,既考虑图像结构相似性,也考虑颜色相似性[43],我们使用与SSIM[33]损失和l1\ell==1}损失混合的损失函数. blocks.en: In experiments, we find that our proposed raindrop detection network gets a relatively low recall at the edge of raindrops. Hence, the B B will preserve some raindrop edge pixels if using the original binary mask M ^ \hat{M} . In order to reduce the number of raindrop pixels in B B , we apply dilation, a basic mathematical morphology operation, to M ^ \hat{M} . It is implemented as a parameter-free layer after the output of raindrop detection network. Fig. 5 shows the effect of dilation operation on a binary mask and the blended input of refine network.
blocks.zh: 在实验中,我们发现我们提议的雨滴探测网络在雨滴的边缘得到相对较低的回想起. 因此,如果使用原始的二进制面具M^\hat{M},BB会保留一些雨滴边缘像素. 为了减少B 中的雨滴像素数量,我们对 M ^\ hat{M} 应用一个基本的数学形态学操作 Dilation 。 它在雨滴检测网络输出后作为无参数层执行. 图5显示了放大操作对二进制面具和精制网络的混合输入的效果.

blocks.en: 4.4 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.4 详细执行情况

blocks.en: Our complete network consists of three different sub-networks, and we train them in a two-stage fashion. In the first stage, we train raindrop detection network and raindrop region reconstruction network respectively because their outputs are dependencies of the refine network. In the second stage, we combine the networks trained on the first stage with refine network to construct our whole network, and we only update the parameters in refine network when training. Limiting the number of trainable parameters in the second stage can be beneficial to prevent our network from overfitting.
blocks.zh: 我们的完整网络由三个不同的子网络组成,我们以两个阶段来训练它们. 在第一阶段,我们分别培训雨滴探测网络和雨滴区域重建网络,因为它们的产出是精炼网络的依赖。 在第二阶段,我们把第一阶段培训的网络与完善网络结合起来,以构建整个网络,我们只是在培训时更新完善网络的参数。 限制第二阶段可训练参数的数量,可以有助于防止我们的网络过于适应。

blocks.en: We do online data augmentation for all training stages. All the images and masks in our training set have resolution of 256 × 512 256\times 512 . Before feeding into the network, a training pair or its horizontal flip will be randomly cropped to 100 × 100 100\times 100 .
blocks.zh: 我们对所有培训阶段进行在线数据扩充。 我们训练场的所有图像和面具 分辨率为256×512 256\times 512。 在输入网络之前,一对训练或者其水平翻转会随机收成100×100100\时100.

blocks.en: Our implementation is built on TensorFlow [ 1 ] and trained on a single NVIDIA TITAN Xp GPU with 12GB memory. All trainable parameters in proposed networks are initialized by Xavier initializer [ 8 ] . The batch size is set to 32 32 , and all three sub-networks are trained for 50 50 epochs which consists of 50 50 K steps per epoch. We adopt Adam [ 18 ] optimizer with initial learning rate = 0.001 =0.001 which is decayed linearly from 20 20 to 40 40 epoch until reaching the ending learning rate = 0.0001 =0.0001 .
blocks.zh: 我们的实现建立在TensorFlow [1]上,并接受过单NVIDIA TITAN Xp GPU的培训,拥有12GB的内存. 拟议网络中的所有可训练参数由Xavier初始化器初始化[8]. 批量大小设定为32 32,所有3个子网络都经过了50个50个纪元的培训,每个纪元由50个50K步组成. 我们采用亚当[18] 优化器,初始学习率=0.001=0.001,从20世纪到40世纪的40世纪线性衰变,直到最终学习率=0.0001=0.0001。

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: In this section, we compare our proposed method to Eigen [ 6 ] , Qian [ 24 ] , DID-MDN [ 42 ] and Pix2Pix [ 17 ] along with ablation experiments. Note that Eigen [ 6 ] and Qian [ 24 ] are the only methods in the literature dedicated to this problem to the best of our knowledge. For this reason, we add a general image-to-image translator Pix2Pix [ 17 ] and a rain streak removal method DID-MDN [ 42 ] in the comparison. We report the PSNR and SSIM metrics in our synthetic dataset and Qian’s dataset.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们将我们拟议的方法与艾根[6],Q[24],DOD-MDN[42]和Pix2Pix[17]以及衰竭实验作比较. 注意艾根[6]和 [24]是文献中唯一专门研究这个问题的方法,据我们所知. 为此原因,我们在比较中增加了一般的图像对图像翻译 Pix2Pix [17] 和雨纹除去方法DOD-MDN [42]. 我们用合成数据集和Qian数据集来报告PSNR和SSIM的度量衡。

blocks.en: First, we evaluate the performance of our raindrop detection network on synthetic dataset which contains the ground truth of binary raindrop masks. Fig. 6 shows Precision-Recall curve of our raindrop detection network. The average precision (AP) of our network prediction is 0.9973 0.9973 . It indicates that our raindrop detection network works very well on synthetic images. Because other methods do not predict the raindrop mask, we cannot compare our raindrop detection network to them.
blocks.zh: 首先,我们评估我们的雨滴探测网络在合成数据集上的性能,其中包含了二进制雨滴面具的地面真相. 图6显示了我们雨滴探测网络的精度-召回曲线. 我国网络预测的平均精度(AP)为0.99730.9973. 这表明,我们的雨滴探测网络在合成图像方面非常有效。 因为其他方法无法预测雨滴掩体,我们不能将我们的雨滴检测网络与它们进行比较.

blocks.en: Table 1 shows quantitative raindrop removal results. It is clearly that our complete model outperforms other methods in terms of both PSNR and SSIM by a large margin.
blocks.zh: 表1显示降雨量清除结果。 显然,我们的完整模型在PSNR和SSIM方面都大大超过其他方法。

blocks.en: Fig. 7 shows the qualitative results of different methods. Our proposed method, Qian [ 24 ] and DID-MDN [ 42 ] remove the most of raindrops successfully while the results produced by Pix2Pix [ 17 ] and Eigen [ 6 ] still contain many raindrops. In the first row of Fig. 7 , there are artifacts in the center of Qian and DID-MDN results. In the second row, there are some raindrops in the bottom of results of Qian and DID-MDN. Our method achieves better performance in both removing raindrops and avoiding artifacts.
blocks.zh: 图7显示了不同方法的质量结果。 我们提议的方法,Qian [24] 和DD-MDN [42] 成功移除了大部分降雨,而Pix2Pix [17]和Eigen [6] 产生的结果仍然包含着许多降雨. Fig. 7的第一行中,Q中央有文物和DOD-MDN成果. 第二行中,Q和DOD-MDN的结果底部出现一些降雨. 我们的方法在清除雨滴和避免文物方面都取得了更好的表现.

blocks.en: We run a number of ablations in order to demonstrate the effectiveness of different modules in our proposed method. The quantitative results are shown in Table 1 . We use the raindrop region reconstruction network as baseline. By adding the raindrop detection network and refine network to the baseline, both PSNR and SSIM are increasing. Then, by replacing the mask with dilated mask, we get our complete proposed architecture which archives the highest PSNR and SSIM. The results of ablation study indicate that all our proposed modules do contribute to the raindrop removal. Our complete architecture improve PSNR by 9.4% compare to the 3RN only. It is a substantially large improvement.
blocks.zh: 我们进行了一些活动,以展示我们拟议方法中不同单元的有效性。 量化结果见表1。 我们把降雨区重建网络作为基线。 通过在基线中增加降雨探测网络和完善网络,PSNR和SSIM都在增加. 然后,通过用膨胀的面具来取代面具, 我们得到了我们提出的完整的架构 将最高的PSNR和SSIM存档。 消化研究的结果表明,我们所有拟议的模块都确实有助于清除降雨。 我们的完整架构改进了PSNR 比3RN只改进了9.4%. 这是一个很大的改进。

blocks.en: The running speed is critical in many outdoor computer vision systems. In order to show the efficiency of our method, we also evaluate the inference speed of prior methods and ours. For a single 256 × 512 256\times 512 image, the inference time of our method is 69.74 69.74 ms, Pix2Pix [ 17 ] is 79.1 79.1 ms, Qian [ 24 ] is 97.16 97.16 ms, Eigen [ 6 ] is 107.712ms and DID-MDN [ 42 ] is 133.64ms. The results indicate that our method is not only effective but also efficient. All the methods are tested on a single NVIDIA TITAN Xp GPU, and the time reported is the average of 20 20 repeats.
blocks.zh: 运行速度在许多户外计算机视觉系统中至关重要. 为了显示我们方法的效率,我们还评估了先前方法和我们方法的推断速度。 对于单幅256×512 256\time 512影像,我们方法的推断时间为69.74 69.74 ms,Pix2Pix [17]为79.1 79.1 ms,Qian [24]为97.16 97.16 ms,Eigen [6]为107.712 ms,DD-MDN [42]为133.64 ms. 结果表明,我们的方法不仅有效,而且有效率。 所有方法都通过单NVIDIA TITAN Xp GPU进行测试,报告的时间平均为20次重复.

blocks.en: 5.2 Experiments on Real-world Image
blocks.zh: 5.2 真实世界图像实验

blocks.en: We evaluate the proposed method on real-world dataset introduced in Qian [ 24 ] . Due to the lack of the ground-truth raindrop mask, we cannot train our complete architecture directly. Instead, we only use low-accuracy masks roughly estimated by subtracting raindrop images with ground truth. We also train our Raindrop Region Reconstruction network (3RN) which do not need raindrop masks. As shown in Table 2 , our methods get competitive results quantitatively that is on par with Qian [ 24 ] . Note the dataset is not very challenging because the data in training set and test set is too similar. Thus all three models can produce compelling visual quality raindrop removal as shown in Fig. 8 .
blocks.zh: 我们评价在Qian [24]中提出的关于现实世界数据集的拟议方法。 由于缺乏地面真实的雨滴面具,我们不能直接训练我们完整的建筑。 相反,我们只使用低准确度的面具, 粗略地估计, 减去雨滴的图像 与地面真相。 我们还培训不需要雨滴口罩的雨滴区域重建网络(3RN)。 如表2所示,我们的方法在数量上获得了与Qian[24]相当的竞争性结果。 注意该数据集不甚具有挑战性,因为培训集和测试集中的数据过于相似. 如图8所示,所有三种模型都可以产生令人信服的视觉质量降雨清除。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 6. 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose a novel end-to-end network to detect and remove adherent raindrop jointly. Since the supervised deep learning in raindrop removal suffers from the lacking of sufficient paired training data, we also develop a practical and realistic dataset for adherent raindrop which contains the pixel-level raindrop binary masks. There are two stages in our proposed multi-task network. In the first stage, two sub-networks detect raindrop locations and restore adherent raindrop regions respectively. In the second stage, a blended image is produced by using the location clues, then a refine network is employed to smooth the blended image. Our experiment results show that the proposed method outperforms the state-of-the-art and can handle both synthetic data and real-world data. In the future, we would like to enhance our raindrop imagery model and extend our experiments to further validate the benefit of using our method on computer vision systems working under the rainy scenes.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出一个全新的端对端网络,共同检测和清除粘着的雨滴. 由于在清除雨滴方面受到监督的深入学习缺乏足够的对接培训数据,我们还为粘附雨滴开发了一个实用和现实的数据集,其中包含像素级雨滴二进制口罩。 我们提议的多任务网络有两个阶段。 在第一阶段,两个子网络分别探测降雨地点和恢复坚持降雨区域。 在第二阶段,利用位置线索生成混合图像,然后使用精细网络来平滑混合图像. 我们的实验结果表明,拟议方法的效绩超过了最新水平,能够同时处理合成数据和现实世界数据. 今后,我们希望加强我们的雨滴图像模型,扩大我们的实验范围,进一步验证在雨景下工作的计算机视觉系统使用我们的方法的益处。
